description: This file contains utility functions for editor commands in the Notesnook project, including content management, focus control, status updates, and interaction with editor components.

methods.name: clearContent
methods.description: Clears the content of the editor and resets related UI components.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus to the editor or pass input based on the 'locked' parameter.

methods.name: blur
methods.description: Removes focus from the editor and related components.

methods.name: setSessionId
methods.description: Sets the current session ID.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the status bar with date and saved status.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Sets the loading state for the editor controller.

methods.name: setInsets
methods.description: Updates safe area insets if the controller exists.

methods.name: updateSettings
methods.description: Updates application settings.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Updates application settings (alias for updateSettings).

methods.name: setTags
methods.description: Sets tags for the current editor tab.

methods.name: clearTags
methods.description: Clears tags for the current editor tab.

methods.name: insertAttachment
methods.description: Inserts an attachment into the editor.

methods.name: setAttachmentProgress
methods.description: Updates the progress of an attachment being uploaded.

methods.name: insertImage
methods.description: Inserts an image into the editor.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Dispatches a back press event.

methods.name: keyboardShown
methods.description: Sets the keyboard visibility state.

methods.name: getTableOfContents
methods.description: Retrieves the table of contents from the editor.

methods.name: focusPassInput
methods.description: Focuses the pass input in the editor controller.

methods.name: blurPassInput
methods.description: Blurs the pass input in the editor controller.

methods.name: createInternalLink
methods.description: Creates an internal link with given attributes.

methods.name: dismissCreateInternalLinkRequest
methods.description: Dismisses the internal link creation request.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewById
methods.description: Scrolls the editor view to a specific element by ID.

methods.name: scrollToSearchResult
methods.description: Scrolls to a specific search result index.
